description: bits-ui's Avatar compiled from its published source through shadcn-svelte's unmodified avatar wrappers, as the avatar demos arrange them (M6 images, docs/design/M6-IMAGES.md): each Avatar.Image loads its pinned source with new Image() and renders an of it (runic.images.json: two GitHub avatars and a pinned 404). Load success (after the default delayMs of 0, the image shows and the fallback hides: wait 0), a pinned 404 showing its fallback (data-status error), a root with delayMs 500 still loading after 300 ms of virtual time and loaded after 550, a source switched at run time from the 404 to an image (the root's onLoadingStatusChange trace is shown), sizes changed from the app (data-size and the size-dependent classes), a badge, a group with a count
